dct_title_s: Potential population exposure around Lewotobi Laki-Laki volcano
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: VO20241105IDN, GDACS ID: 1000099** This map illustrates the population potentially exposed following the Lewotobi Laki-Laki volcanic eruption. Based on Worldpop spatial demographic data, ~11,400; ~26,000 and 37,000 people live within a 5km; 7.5km and 10km radius zone from the volcano crater. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
